purpose: Clomipramine is mainly used to treat obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), which involves unwanted repeated thoughts or behaviors that are hard to control. It can also be used for depression, panic disorder, and some chronic pain conditions. Your doctor has prescribed it to help reduce those distressing thoughts and compulsions so you can feel more in control of your daily life.
how_it_works: This medication works by increasing the levels of certain natural chemicals in your brain, especially serotonin and norepinephrine. These chemicals are like messengers that help regulate your mood, anxiety, and thought patterns. By keeping more of these messengers active in your brain, clomipramine helps calm the overactive signals that cause obsessive thoughts and compulsive behaviors.
common_side_effects: Dry mouth, drowsiness or feeling sleepy, dizziness especially when standing up quickly, constipation, blurred vision, increased sweating, weight gain, difficulty urinating, and sexual problems such as decreased desire or difficulty with orgasm. Many of these ease up after the first few weeks as your body adjusts.
warnings: Do not stop taking this medication suddenly without talking to your doctor, as this can cause withdrawal symptoms like nausea, headache, and irritability. It may increase suicidal thoughts in children, teenagers, and young adults, especially at the start of treatment, so watch for mood changes and contact your doctor right away if this happens. Avoid alcohol as it can increase drowsiness and dizziness. Tell your doctor if you have heart problems, seizures, glaucoma, or are taking other medications, especially MAOIs, as dangerous interactions can occur. This medicine can also lower your seizure threshold.
typical_dosing: Adults usually start at a low dose of 25 mg per day, taken with meals to reduce stomach upset. The dose is gradually increased over several weeks, typically up to 100 to 250 mg per day depending on how you respond and how well you tolerate it. It is often taken once daily at bedtime to help reduce daytime drowsiness. It may take 4 to 10 weeks before you notice the full benefit, so be patient and keep taking it as directed.
